topic: Science Process Skills and Material Properties
key_concepts: Hand span is measured from thumb tip to small finger tip with hand opened wide.
A ruler measures length and draws straight lines.
Scissors cut cloth, paper, cardboard, and other thin materials.
A hand lens is curved glass that makes objects look larger.
Fingerprints are unique patterns on fingers.
Balloons expand when inflated with air, and air from a balloon can make things move.
Objects have characteristics such as size, weight, and texture.
A marble is smaller but heavier than a ping pong ball.
Asking questions that can be tested is an important part of doing science.
Spinning means turning quickly; vibrating means moving back and forth rapidly.
Clay balls sink in water, but clay can be shaped and tested to try to make it float.
Science investigation involves planning, designing, creating, and testing.
